systemStatus.headline: Sun Aug 23 7:15 AM data refresh. Saturday Toast landed and it is a huge number that needs verifying ($16.7k net, $92/order). Today is thin in the kitchen -- one cook on the whole roster. And the Google review flagged as a food-safety allegation is still sitting unanswered.
systemStatus.detail:
SUN AUG 23, 7:15 AM PT DATA REFRESH RUN. Sources pulled: Toast (group nightly email), Sling, Google Ads (live dashboard), Yelp Ads (live dashboard), TripAdvisor (email).

1. TOAST SAT AUG 22 -- VERIFY BEFORE TRUSTING. Group email reports gross $16,921.75 / net $16,721.45 on 181 orders and 278 guests. That is $92.38 per order and $60.15 per guest, about 2.5x the recent run rate (Fri Aug 21 was $35.98/order on $7,160.85 net). The numbers are internally consistent inside the email, so it is either a genuine large-event Saturday or a group-rollup artifact. The 229 W Montecito single-location summary had not arrived by 7:15 AM -- it lands ~7:39 AM -- and will settle the question. Labor came in at 13.3% of net, the lowest in the recent series, which is what you would expect if the sales number is real and the roster was normal. 1 order left open; Harmony Willson auto-clocked out.

2. TODAY'S ROSTER IS KITCHEN-LIGHT. 11 employees, 13 shifts, 55.50 hours, 0 uncovered, 5.25 OT hours. Only one kitchen body scheduled all day: Isael Salvador Narciso, Cook. If Saturday was genuinely a $16.7k day, one cook on Sunday is worth a second look.

3. GOOGLE ADS PICKED UP. Sat Aug 22: 288 impressions, 20 clicks, 6.94% CTR, $21.71 spend, $1.09 avg CPC -- spend more than doubled vs Friday and CTR improved from 4.78%. Conversions still reading 0.00 / calculating. Structural problem unchanged: only 1 of 4 campaigns is serving. Both Performance Max campaigns are paused with "All asset groups limited by policy" -- that policy block is the actual fix.

4. YELP: AUDIENCE SIZE DROPPED FROM IDEAL TO LIMITED. Ad is live. Last 30 days: 40.6k ad impressions (79% of total), 369 ad clicks, 437 page visits from ads (56%), 103 leads from ads (67%). Billing Aug 1-22: $304.73 spend, $1.10 CPC, $3.96 CPL. Yelp warns that control features limiting the audience push CPC up. Also: the Reviews tab badge moved from 1 to 2 and the inbox still shows 15 unread.

5. TRIPADVISOR: nothing new. No ad-performance report in the last 24h.

6. CARRIED FORWARD, NOT RE-CHECKED THIS RUN -- the Google review queue. As of the 4:05 AM run, Donald Clay's 1-star food-safety allegation on The Brewhouse listing was DAY 16 unanswered, with 5 unreplied reviews on The Brewhouse (4.5 stars / 527) and 1 on Brewhouse Coffee (5.0 / 5). This refresh run did not re-open the Business Profile UI, so those counts are from 4:05 AM. The food-safety review is the highest-value item on this dashboard and it has now been unanswered longer than any other open thread.

I'd like to look into your visit directly -- please reach me at the restaurant at (805) 884-4664 or mojobrewhouse@gmail.com so I can get the details. unanswered.handlingNote: DO NOT POST WITHOUT REVIEW. Public allegation of foodborne illness. Recommend: (1) pull the Aug 8 lunch ticket and taco prep/temp logs before responding, (2) notify your insurance carrier, (3) consider a quick call with counsel. Never admit or deny causation in a public reply -- acknowledge, express concern, move it offline.
